statement: A content-only classifier can silently regain path dependence when it reuses a legacy preprocessing helper whose exception predicates inspect the filename. In Cejel v24, the inherited V47 Algolia public-search-key sanitizer used the documentation path to decide whether to blank an apiKey, so identical configuration bytes under docs/ and src/ reached classification differently. Fix: make the v24 invocation select a content-only public-key context, preserve legacy path behavior for earlier rubric versions, and test the inherited branch with identical bytes in both locations.
